items.evidence: desktop-music-viewport: labels (TRACK/SOURCE/LENGTH), row-meta (3:00, DEL) and the dim volume readout 0.7 all legible against near-black; idle gray only on the empty SOURCE/LOOP slots.
all 8 shots: amber phosphor on dark throughout (buttons, fills, tabs); no green anywhere, no red outside the danger buttons (mobile-music-full CLEAR QUEUE).

desktop-music-viewport and mobile-music-viewport: bright L corner bracket sits only on the playing NOW PLAYING panel frame (top-left); LINK/SEARCH/QUEUE panels carry only boxed-title chips; nav underline under MUSIC/HOME, no brackets.

desktop-music-viewport: boxed titles align per panel, queue row shows 01 second | 3:00 | DEL in a right-hand meta column, CLEAR QUEUE in a segmented bottom strip; transport reads as one segmented row.
mobile-music-full: single column, transport wraps to two rows (PREV/PAUSE/SKIP then LOOP OFF + slider + times) in the same amber console language; nothing orphaned.

desktop-music-viewport and mobile-music-viewport: progress track now paints as a visible line between the volume control and the time readout, no overlap or cutoff; transport judged on viewport shots per skill (full-page fixed-bar seam ignored).
all 8 shots: scanlines barely perceptible, no per-element glow, no badges or HUD excess after the transport CSS fix.
